core_research_thesis: Optimization of battery cell design through the integration of electrochemical principles, materials science, and electrical engineering to enhance energy storage mechanisms and efficiency
state_of_the_art_prior_art: Graphene and nanomaterials in energy storage
proven_facts: The Nernst equation relates electrode potential to concentration
The Butler-Volmer equation describes electrode kinetics
Fick's laws of diffusion govern ionic transport in electrolytes
Cycle life and charge/discharge rates impact battery performance
critical_unanswered_unknowns: Optimal materials selection for high-performance battery cells
Quantitative relationship between materials properties and battery efficiency
Scalability and cost-effectiveness of solid-state battery manufacturing
Long-term stability and safety of advanced battery chemistries
